siteMetadata.title: #COCONUT - Computer Club
siteMetadata.description: COCONUT Computer Club (Computer Club Oriented Network, Utility & Technology) is a think-tank and research community based in Makassar, Indonesia, established in 2008.

node.description: Building and safeguarding the resilient backbone of modern networks. Our focus spans secure distributed systems, scalable cloud computing, next-generation 5G/6G architectures, and advanced threat defense for critical digital environments.

projects.name: VulneraX
projects.description: VulneraX operates in security services such as red teaming, and builds a Ransomware Readiness Assessment platform alongside VulneraLab, which actively produces threat intelligence and analyzes the latest threats. Its Threat Hunting & Incident Response services have successfully penetrated the financial industry and government markets.

projects.name: KotaCloud
projects.description: KotaCloud is a cloud platform delivering public and private Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), and Software as a Service (SaaS), including managed cloud-native application services.

projects.name: Jalaranu
projects.description: Jalaranu is a modular underlake data center project building computing infrastructure beneath Indonesian lakes. It evaluates thermal efficiency, operational reliability, and deployment feasibility compared to land-based data centers with water-based cooling, connecting shore-based support facilities with a submerged computing module.

projects.name: INESA
projects.description: Inovasi dan Edukasi Desa (INESA): a smart farming platform powered by IoT and AI that brings real-time land monitoring, AI-based recommendations, and automatic irrigation to Indonesian villages, starting with Desa Rajang, Pinrang.

node.description: Intersecting computer science with complex economic ecosystems. Our work applies quantitative finance and data-driven modeling across traditional banking, capital markets, and decentralized cryptocurrency networks.
Driving tech-enabled innovation in sustainable power. We conduct applied research in renewable energy integration, advanced energy storage optimization, and smart grid management systems.

Bridging computing and medicine. Our projects leverage health informatics, computer vision for medical diagnostics, and predictive modeling to enhance digital healthcare infrastructure and clinical outcomes.

Transforming knowledge delivery through technology. We develop adaptive learning platforms, educational technology (EdTech) architectures, and data-driven tools to optimize the modern learning experience.

projects.name: KOLAH
projects.description: KOLAH is an interactive online learning platform that connects people who want to learn with quality courses. It also aims to help honorary teachers in Indonesia earn additional income, addressing the challenge of their modest salaries.
